text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. The crowd 
buzzes with excitement over the showdown 
between Special Week and Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Staying out of the limelight is the real 
opportunity. Everything is set in motion. 
Seiun Sky, the fully revived tactician, 
will turn Nakayama upside down at year's 
end—!
